texts.zh:
我们派往星海共同体的使者，[event_envoy.GetName]，最近花在照料一只跟在[event_envoy.GetHerHim]身边的奇异小型哺乳动物的时间多到令人不安。想必这是某位其他代表的家庭宠物，它可爱非常，但没有任何开智的迹象。尽管它十分喜好肉食，牙尖爪利，总体上却温柔喜人，希望以抚摸的形式大量进行身体上的接触——可它的脾气有时会变得暴烈。

尽管这只生物已被证明会让[event_envoy.GetName]从更为严肃的任务中分心，其他代表却对[Root.GetSpeciesName]心灵中柔软、感性、惹人爱慕的一面多加赞誉。
texts.en:
[event_envoy.GetName], our emissary to the Galactic Community, has been spending a disturbing amount of time tending to a strange, small mammalian creature that began following [event_envoy.GetHerHim] around. Presumably a domestic pet that escaped from one of the other delegations, it is undeniably cute but shows no sign of sapient thought. Although it is highly carnivorous and exhibits sharp teeth and claws, it is generally affectionate and desires plentiful physical contact in the form of petting - though its mood swings can be sudden and violent!

Although the creature has proved a distraction for [event_envoy.GetName]'s more serious tasks, other delegates have commented on the endearing nature of the softer, more sentimental side of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] psyche that has been revealed.
